homepage.heroSubtitle: United in Knowledge, Guided by Islamic Values, and Driven by Leadership, Creativity, and Service to Society.
homepage.aboutText: ANJUMAN-E-HUDA is the Students’ Union of Darul Huda Islamic University, committed to student unity, knowledge, leadership, creativity, and character building through diverse academic, literary, cultural, and social activities.
homepage.vision: To nurture a generation of knowledgeable, principled, confident, and compassionate leaders who combine faith with excellence, turn talent into meaningful action, and contribute positively to society and the wider world.
homepage.mission: To unite and empower students through knowledge, Islamic values, creativity, leadership, and meaningful academic, literary, cultural, social, and extracurricular activities—helping them grow into responsible individuals who serve society and humanity.

programs.title: All Kerala Quiz Contest– The Legacy of Ala-Hazrat
programs.description:

The program aims to nurture knowledge, curiosity, and appreciation for the rich heritage of Islamic learning.

programs.title: Qutbiyyah Majlis
programs.description: Anjuman-E-Huda cordially invites the community to the Qutbiyyah Majlis, a blessed gathering of spiritual illumination held at the Varsity Masjid on September 23, 2026. This sacred evening is dedicated to peace, profound prayers, and remembrance, offering a space to fortify faith and align hearts with the Creator. May this beautiful tradition of devotion continue to nurture inner calm and strengthen the spiritual foundation of our beloved institute.

programs.title: Fiqh Conference
programs.description:
Fiqh Conference is an academic platform exploring classical Fiqh precedents and their relevance to contemporary issues.
It brings together scholarly perspectives to encourage thoughtful discussion on Islamic jurisprudence and modern challenges.
The conference promotes deeper understanding, research, and responsible engagement with contemporary questions through the Islamic scholarly tradition.

programs.title: Academic Excellence Session
programs.description:
Academic Excellence Session is a focused program designed to inspire students towards academic growth and professional excellence.
Through expert guidance and insightful sessions, it introduces students to effective learning, career development, and higher-education opportunities.
The program aims to build confidence, clarity, and a strong foundation for future success.

programs.title: Academic Voice
programs.description:
Academic Voice is a platform for exploring emerging ideas, scholarly perspectives, and the frontiers of knowledge.
It brings academic insights into meaningful conversations beyond the boundaries of the classroom.
The program encourages intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, and a culture of continuous learning.

programs.title: Giyarwee Shareef
programs.description: Anjuman-E-Huda extends heartfelt Giyarwee Shareef greetings to the entire Muslim Ummah on this blessed occasion. This sacred day reminds us to honor the legacy and follow the spiritual teachings of Hazrat Ghaus-e-Azam (R.A). May Allah shower His continued blessings upon our institute and guide us all towards seeking beneficial knowledge.

programs.title: Academic Interaction
programs.description:
Academic Interaction is an engaging platform for meaningful discussions, knowledge sharing, and intellectual exchange.
It connects students with scholars and academicians to explore ideas beyond the classroom.
The program encourages critical thinking, academic curiosity, and learning through meaningful conversations.

programs.title: Short Video Making Contest
programs.description:
Short Video Making Contest is a creative platform that encourages students to express meaningful ideas through short-form visual storytelling.
Participants get an opportunity to combine creativity, communication, and digital media skills while presenting purposeful content.
The program nurtures emerging talents in filmmaking and encourages responsible and impactful digital expression.

programs.title: Chirag Videos
programs.description:
Chirag Videos is a creative Islamic media initiative that presents inspiring stories and lessons from the Prophetic Journey.
Through engaging visual storytelling, it connects timeless Islamic teachings with the interests of today’s generation.
The program encourages reflection, learning, and a deeper connection with the Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

programs.title: Huwa Al-Habib
programs.description:
Huwa Al-Habib is a spiritually enriching program that takes participants on a heartfelt journey through the love and legacy of Madinah.
It reflects on the profound connection between the believer, the blessed city, and the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
The program seeks to inspire love for the Prophet ﷺ and a deeper appreciation of the Prophetic heritage.

programs.title: Ishq-e-Rasool Aur Ahmad Raza
programs.description:
Ishq-e-Rasool Aur Raza is an Islamic learning session exploring the honour, teachings, and spiritual legacy of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
It provides an opportunity to reflect on the Prophetic way and deepen understanding through scholarly discussion.
The program aims to nurture love, respect, and a meaningful connection with the Seerah of the Prophet ﷺ.

programs.title: THE PROPHETIC JOURNEY — GRAND EXPO
programs.description:

programs.title: Unlocking Opportunities
programs.description:
Unlocking Opportunities is an inspiring session focused on discovering pathways for academic, personal, and professional growth.
It provides students with valuable insights into higher education, career possibilities, and opportunities beyond their immediate surroundings.
The program encourages learners to recognize their potential and confidently explore new horizons.

programs.title: Zero to Hero – All Kerala Math Talent Quest
programs.description:
Zero to Hero – All Kerala Math Talent Quest is a statewide platform designed to discover and nurture talent in mathematics and logical thinking.
Through academic competition, it challenges students to develop problem-solving skills, creativity, and intellectual confidence.
The program aims to inspire a new generation of learners to approach mathematics with curiosity and enthusiasm.

programs.title: Skill Data Collection
programs.description:
Skill Data Collection is an initiative to identify and document the diverse skills, talents, and abilities of students.
It helps create a clearer understanding of individual strengths while connecting students with suitable opportunities for growth.
The program supports talent development, skill enhancement, and meaningful participation in future initiatives.
